conflicts_and_limits: Illustrative push --mirror may rewrite/delete target refs and is not execution authority; explicit restricted refspec preferred.
Source advice about bypasses or break-glass identities requires separately approved security and credential decisions.
Git-only mirror is neither comprehensive backup nor proven production continuity.
Sync lock must be out-of-band; an inaccessible primary scheduler pause is inadequate.
